description: Static AAA review of the project, no Godot needed: API correctness (Godot 3 code, unknown classes, functions, members, signals, wrong argument counts, missing input actions), performance, code quality and structure. Returns a 0-100 score per category, then one line per finding: `res://file.gd:12: error [rule] message`; `detail` full adds the fix under each finding. Pass `files` to list only findings in files you changed. Pass `code` and `file` to review GDScript before writing it to disk. Pass `only_new: true` while you are fixing: new findings in full, the ones you already saw as one short line each, and how many are fixed. It never changes your code; it keeps the last review in .godot/godotwright/ for `only_new` and counts rule hits in the local learning file. For errors only the engine finds, run godot_check after it; godot_checklist lists every rule.

code.description: unsaved GDScript to review in place of the file on disk

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

file.description: res:// path the code belongs to (required with code)

files.description: only show findings in these res:// files

only_new.description: show only what changed since the last review of this project (saves tokens in a fix loop)

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

name: godot_review
title: AAA review
